title: Mechanical Lift-Access Fee Rate Card, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Rate card.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a mechanical lift-access fee is added to the mechanical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The mechanical lift-access fee follows the customer-pay service the coverage was issued on, held under Customer-Pay Repairs:

| Customer-Pay Repairs service the coverage was issued on | Mechanical lift-access fee |
|---|---|
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | full-body lift fee, USD 19.95 |
| Complete Refinish Service | full-body lift fee, USD 19.95 |
| Panel Repair Service | panel lift fee, USD 9.95 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | panel lift fee, USD 9.95 |
| any other source work | no mechanical lift-access fee |

## Notes to the card

- The service read is the one on the customer-pay repair order the coverage was issued on.
- A coverage issued on any other source work, including an insurance claim repair, takes no mechanical lift-access fee.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued on a Complete Refinish Service: USD 19.95 is added.
- One issued on a Bumper Refinish Service: USD 9.95 is added.
- A Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty issued on a Structural Claim Repair: nothing is added.
